text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe found herself pondering the 
word "Leckermäulchen."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She recalled the cryptic words T.M. Opera 
O had once proclaimed: "The Consort of 
Leckermaul."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, Agnes Tachyon informed 
Trainer that she would be acting 
separately during the summer training 
camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp began, swirling 
with various hidden motives.
